Name: Busty Zuzu City Girl (Shiko) - FluffyCakeChan Alt.
Author: FluffyCakeChan
Description:
Hello! I'm not real stardew valley modder, I just bought game 2 days ago haha! I love mods so I come download many mods here! I enjoy "Shiko - New Custom NPC" mod and I am simple man I enjoy "Busty Zuzu City Girl (Shiko)" mod but the art was not my taste so I remade the portrait arts for me and I felt it's good to share with everyone else!

I plan to do the world sprites too sometime, but this my first time doing pixel art like this so it might take while!
(i realized this mod is jojo reference with glasses on she looks like lisa lisa so epic)


Anyways! If you enjoy give endorsemants to original mods I don't make this without them ♥!

Busty Zuzu City Girl (Shiko) - https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5374
